input.objective: Launch PLEA test run 5 on Sepolia from this Foundry repository exactly as launch.json lists it: five contracts (PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, PleaLaunch), deployed in order in one transaction with the constructor arguments in launch.json. This is the code your test run 4 job 2234e9a2 (launch #1466) audited, adapted and deployed (commit adb9f44 of its launch repository, including your adapt step's hook dirty-hookData fall-through, your Letterbox appeal minimum raise and your four test files), plus a fix round and one new feature. Fix round, from the run-4 judge's two low findings and the Sepolia live test: (a) Letterbox: an APPEAL letter of a floor-sized plea is no longer refused TooSmallForTheFee; after the same-share clamp an appeal under the 0.70 IMD floor is raised to the floor amount, capped at the original amount and at 50% of the balance, and the worth-the-fee check is not applied again to appeals. (b) Seasons also excludes the launch owner, read from the hook's owner() with a non-reverting staticcall; the pending owner of a two-step handover is deliberately NOT excluded (excluding it would let the owner strip a season leader by nominating them, the run-3 finding; your OwnershipTransitionInvariant keeps that expectation). (c) CabalGate's appeal question states the real previous score and need ('which the Cabal DENIED at 32 against a need of 33'). (d) CabalGate.DEFINITIONS version 3 adds under stories that naming the earlier verdict or score in an appeal is not manipulation (two wording trims keep the value under 512 characters); keep the definitions text exactly as it is. New: Objection! (src/Tribunal.sol, ownerless, deployed after the launch through PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode) against the keccak256 committed as PleaLaunch's new 13th argument; a zero hash would mean no objections). For 20 minutes after the Cabal approves a plea, anyone except the seller and the wallets Seasons excludes may object: 1-280 bytes under the gate's text rules (plus no [OBJECTION markers), the 0.5 IMD oracle fee (on Sepolia the Tribunal mints the test fee, like the Letterbox) and a 0.35 IMD stake in pool IMD. The Tribunal asks Intake v2 with requestWithFailure, the same body parameters as the gate (panel 30, quorum 17, tolerance 1500, guards 0-45), the gate's own question for the plea verbatim plus the original score and the objection as untrusted text, and the gate's five definitions members verbatim (a test checks the copy against gate.body) plus one objection member; it verifies attestations with OracleAttestationConsumer under its own EIP-712 domain and the gate's signer, with the gate's panel, expiry and score checks, and stores only. Ruling: sustained when newScore + 2 < need (the plea earns no points this season, the stake comes back); otherwise overruled (the stake goes to Seasons' prize pot through settle, which also calls checkpoint); a refused or split panel, or 20 minutes without a ruling, makes the objection void (stake back, oracle fee spent). The recorded score becomes the lowest any panel gave, never higher than the original. At most two rulings per plea, from different wallets; a sustain closes the case; one pending objection at a time. Seasons.record refuses a plea while its window is open or an objection is pending (Held) and for good after a sustain (ObjectionSustained); closeSeason skips such pleas; Seasons reads the Tribunal through PLEA's launcher with non-reverting staticcalls, so with no Tribunal nothing changes. Window plus expiry (40 minutes) end inside the 1-hour close grace (a test asserts it). The sale is never touched and rulings never reset the dead-man. Numbers changed by the project owner for this run: PLEA.init mints 82% to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor (the swarm's 10% and a 2% airdrop, one root); the PLEA bonus is 10,000,000 PLEA for each of the first six seasons; Seasons pays the top 25 wallets with 60 or more points shares from 450 down to 350 basis points in a straight line (Seasons.shareBps, SHARES packed two bytes per rank, 10,000 in all), for the IMD pot and the bonus alike; the Letterbox leaderboard reads shareBps and lists 25 ranks. Everything else is run 4's as you deployed it: letters as raw input data or letter(text), APPEAL, SELL and NAME, 20% letters in escrow, fees paid in PLEA by an exact-output swap capped at the snapshot value plus 10%, deliver by anyone for at least 95% of the snapshot value with the 0.35 IMD fee (never more than the sale) to the season pot and the 0.25 IMD runner tip, settle on every other ending, APPEAL letters clamped to the original plea's share, status and leaderboard text views, display names, CabalGate's Letterbox-only submitFor/appealFor/executeSellFor and plea flags, imd/acc's trader rule in PleaHook (hookData, else the router's msgSender() with 30,000 gas, else a plain-wallet sender; never a router, tx.origin, the Stacker, the IMD token, the sIMD vault, the PoolManager or the hook), no keeper tip in rebalance(), Ownable2Step, pleas of 1% to 50% of the balance (or 2.5M PLEA) with share bands 18/11/5 at 20%/35%, no Laureates, the behaviour-preserving gas pass. test/Tribunal.t.sol, TribunalSeasons.t.sol and TribunalAdversarial.t.sol cover the new contract (flows, payouts, window edges, the two-ruling case, eligibility, text rules, question and body JSON, strangers, replays, the gate's signatures, bad panels, late callbacks, a fuzzed stake-accounting check); test/fork/ForkTestnet.t.sol (SEPOLIA_RPC_URL) and test/fork/ForkMainnet.t.sol (MAINNET_RPC_URL) rehearse against the live Intake v2 and an Ethereum fork. The launch transaction must fit Ethereum's 16,777,216 per-transaction gas cap with your deployer's headroom: test/LaunchManifest.t.sol measures it as the chain charges it plus your factory's overhead (GASPLAIN, GASHEAD with 22% headroom) and asserts it, and also measures deployTribunal; keep any fix within that. Audit the imported code and deploy it unchanged; fix only what the audit proves is a real bug, and keep every number as it is (fees, timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 5-hour seasons, 33-hour dead-man, START 1792162800, credit gas 1300000, letters 20%, plea maximum 50%, share bands 20/35, tip 0.25 IMD, auto-sell fee 0.35 IMD, 0.70 IMD minimum plea value, 95% sale minimum, fee cap +10%, 1% plea minimum, six bonus seasons of 10,000,000 PLEA, the 82/6/12 split, top 25 from 450 to 350 bps, objection window 20 minutes, objection stake 0.35 IMD, margin 2, two rulings per plea, msgSender gas 30000, no keeper tip). If you change the Letterbox or the Tribunal, update its code hash in launch.json. Runtime sizes: CabalGate 24,376 bytes (200 under the EIP-170 limit), PleaHook 24,296 (280 under), Letterbox SIZELB, Tribunal SIZETR, Seasons SIZESE: keep any fix within them. Keep PLEA.setLauncher accepting either the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block. Keep foundry.toml as it is, including [lint] lint_on_build = false and the read-only fs_permissions for ./out and ./launch.json.
